svg.title: Motion Guidance and Appearance Refinement Pipeline
svg.desc: Editable native SVG reconstruction of a two-part figure. Panel (a) shows extraction of first-frame Gaussians, optimized 4D Gaussians, 3D editing, anchor construction from source and edited Gaussians, anchor-correspondence optimal transport, and motion guidance. Panel (b) shows appearance refinement using rendered first frames, warped images, optical-flow-based warping, loss computation, color uncertainty estimation, optical flow rendering, view-time sampling, rasterization, and edited Gaussian deformation.

g.desc: Inventory: left text boxes, two oval rendered-room thumbnails with camera icons, vertical and horizontal arrows, central anchor construction box with Gaussian circles and anchor point clouds, turquoise correspondence transport box, gray motion-guidance region with green Gaussian ellipses, purple dashed correspondences, anchor points and legend.

Inventory: lower panel contains label, render-first-frames text, vertical stack of three edited-room thumbnails, a dashed warped-image block with four thumbnails and an orange optical-flow-based warping module, a cyan loss equation strip, an uncertainty block containing a black uncertainty map, color uncertainty estimation, rendered t-th-frame thumbnails, a three-box rendering/sampling/rasterization chain, and a rounded deformation frame with four blue Gaussian point clouds.
g.text: Loss Computation Lrefine(warpt * Ut, rendert * Ut)
